verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Indian government has not announced any scheme to provide free mobile recharges. Messages and videos claiming this are false and often part of a scam to get you to click on fraudulent links.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Numerous fact-checking organizations and news outlets, including The Quint, NewsOnAir, NDTV, and BOOM, have consistently debunked claims about the Indian government or Prime Minister Modi offering free mobile recharges. The government's official fact-checking arm, PIB Fact Check, has repeatedly clarified that no such scheme exists. These false claims, which have circulated for years in various forms (e.g., tied to elections, festivals, or using edited videos), are often scams designed to trick users into clicking malicious links.
